items.q: Where do my notes actually go?
items.a: Nowhere. SQLite and the vector store live on your devices, the iPhone ↔ Mac sync runs directly over your Wi-Fi, encrypted. Only the AI requests (cloud transcription if you choose it, embeddings, chat) leave - with your own API keys.
The app is free. You only pay for your API usage (OpenAI, and Soniox if you use cloud transcription) - a few cents per real use. Local Whisper transcription is free and unlimited.

items.q: Does it work without a connection?
items.a: Capture, transcription (local Whisper model) and reading your notes: yes, airplane mode included. AI chat needs the network to query the model.

Tools your voice triggers: connectors (n8n, WhatsApp, email, webhooks), automations, programs. Installable in one tap, some free, some paid - and open to third-party creators, in a controlled way. Under construction.
iPhone (iOS 16+, App Store) and Apple Silicon Mac (DMG on GitHub). First launch on Mac: right-click > Open.
Yes, it is all on GitHub (EUPL). 100% Rust, Dioxus for the UI. You can build and install it on your own iPhone with a single make.
